lines.speaker: Kelsier
lines.text: You made it. Not many do, their first night out from under a crew leader's thumb.

lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: What do you want with me?

lines.speaker: Kelsier
lines.text: A Mistborn who's never been trained is a knife nobody's holding by the handle. I want to teach you to hold it. And I want your help with something bigger than Camon ever dreamed of.

lines.speaker: Kelsier
lines.text: Then you walk, with a vial of metal in your pocket and my thanks for hearing me out. But I don't think you will. Drink up — steel, iron and tin are yours now. Come inside and meet the crew.
